Name: Case Count where Lead Time Over value (group of cases granularity)
Explanation: Number of cases belonging to a group of cases whose lead time is greater than a given value.

Name: Case Percentage where Lead Time Over value (group of cases granularity)
Explanation: Percentage of cases belonging to a group of cases whose lead time is greater than a given value.

Name: Case count and Lead Time Ratio (group of cases granularity)
Explanation: Ratio between the number of cases belonging to a group of cases and the lead time of a group of cases.
